summary: A reconcile pass keeps each seat's work-wake message views beside their subjects and reads one again only when that message changes. It no longer refolds every wake a seat was ever sent each time the shared message cache, which mailbox reads also fill, empties

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: A kept view is reused under the same version key the shared message cache uses (the message's newest claim and its selected declaration), so passes see the same wakes, statuses and order.

recovery.detail: The views live only in memory; swapping back to an older build restores the previous reads.
